main.description: Get information about a Streamplace broadcaster.

broadcaster.description: DID of the Streamplace broadcaster to which this server belongs

server.description: DID of this particular Streamplace server

admins.description: Array of DIDs authorized as admins

moqURL.description: moqt:// URL of this server's Media over QUIC listener, which peers push streams to and pull them from; a certhash query parameter pins the server certificate (SHA-256, hex) when it is self-signed. Absent when the listener is off.
